title: PostMessage via eval
description: Receives messages via window postMessage without origin verification and executes the message content directly inside eval().
objectives: Identify the postMessage event listener in the page.
Notice the absence of origin check on event.origin.
Send a message that executes JavaScript via eval().
hints: From DevTools console or an attacker iframe: window.postMessage('alert(1)', '*').
body:
PostMessage Receiver (eval sink)

This page listens for message events and passes event.data directly into eval() without checking event.origin.
